newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Oct aluminium exports up 16 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Oct aluminium exports up 16 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Russian primary aluminium and aluminium alloy exports in the first 10 months of the year were were 2.13 million tonnes, up 16 percent on 1995, Interfax news agency quoted the State Customs Committee as saying on Monday.
The Committee's data said aluminum exports in October were 209,830 tonnes, including 193,600 tonnes of primary aluminium and 16,230 tonnes of alloys, Interfax said.
It said October aluminium and alloy exports were 10.5 percent up on September levels.
